none: PAS NLM-D075C9: Roman Coin: Radiate of Tetricus II
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Radiate of Tetricus II (272-274), Reece period 13. Obverse description: Radiate bust cuirassed right, no beard. Obverse inscription: [--]ICVS AVG. Reverse description: Female figure advancing left, possibly Spes. Reverse inscription: SP[ES] AVG. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 19.4mm, Weight: 1.31gms, die axis: 12
